rationale.consistency: Special-cases 'order' in evaluateGlobalOptionsBlock exactly like servers/log/default_bind; error strings, slices idioms, and field-doc style match the package; gofmt realignment done.
rationale.edge_cases: Handles nil options map, nil per-adaptation order fallback, non-[]string existing value, accumulation of repeated order lines, invalid order erroring with no residue, and shared-map concurrency via maps.Clone.
rationale.scope: Core change is focused; maps.Clone of options and the RegisterDirectiveOrder rewrite go slightly beyond minimum but are justified by the shared-map/default-order requirements. Unexported sortRoutes/buildSubroute signatures changed.
rationale.readability: Clear names and explicit threading of order; a few comments are wordier than needed but explain non-obvious intent well.
rationale.robustness: No global writes outside init-time RegisterDirectiveOrder; parseOptOrder clones before DeleteFunc/Insert so default and shared slices are never mutated; no locks needed. slices.Insert(-1) path is unreachable given invariants.
rationale.maintainability: Explicit parameter passing avoids hidden coupling, but order is now plumbed through three functions plus a Helper field, and the directiveOrder fallback is duplicated in parseOptOrder and buildSubroute.
